name: Platform File Source
shortDescription: Download a file from a platform dataset (databank) and load it into the pipeline as Parquet
description: Logs in to the platform with your own account (username and password stored as secrets in Settings, Secrets), downloads a file from a platform dataset's databank through the file server, and writes it as a Parquet file for the next nodes. Supports CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, GeoPackage and Parquet files (shapes become a geometry column of GeoJSON text). Give the dataset (databank) ID, and the file's path inside it when the databank holds more than one file. Use a * pattern or a folder in the file path to stack many files into one table.

name.label: Name
name.description: Unique identifier for this source node in the pipeline

databank_id.label: Dataset (databank) ID
databank_id.description: The ID of the platform dataset, as shown in its page address

file_key.label: File path in the dataset
file_key.description: Which file to download, for example data/people.csv. Leave empty if the dataset has exactly one file. To load several files into one table, use a pattern such as 2026-09-*.parquet, a folder ending in / (data/), or just * for every file.

all_files.label: Load all matching files
all_files.description: Optional. Using a * pattern or a folder in the file path already loads several files; this switch does the same and, when the file path is empty, loads every file. Several files are stacked into one table with an extra _source_file column.

max_files.label: Most files to load
max_files.description: Safety limit when several files are loaded. The node stops with a message if more files match.

layer.label: Layer name (GeoPackage)
layer.description: Only for GeoPackage (.gpkg) files that hold more than one layer: which layer to load. The error message lists the layer names.

username_secret.label: Username secret name
username_secret.description: Name of the secret that holds your platform username (email). Create it in Settings, Secrets.

password_secret.label: Password secret name
password_secret.description: Name of the secret that holds your platform password. Create it in Settings, Secrets.

file_server_url.label: File server address (advanced)
file_server_url.description: Leave empty to use the platform's file server

token_url.label: Login address (advanced)
token_url.description: Leave empty to use the platform's login server
